name: Miklotov McMahon
japaneseName: マイクロトフ・マクマホン
description: Miklotov McMahon is the head representative of the Council of Wise Men, effectively serving as the governing intellect of the Kingdom of Lugunica in the absence of a reigning monarch. Renowned as a hero of civil administration since the Demihuman War, he oversaw the commencement of the Royal Selection in Arc 3 and continues to guide state affairs through subsequent national crises.
